futures.name: Thomas Speer
futures.case: Puka locked in the 9th, then ARSB, Hampton, and McBride. Best roster in the league, and he's chasing ring four.

futures.name: Brian Heino
futures.case: Achane in the 12th is the steal of the night, and Saquon fell to 11. The RBs are a title window.

futures.name: Bryan Hunt
futures.case: Chase at 3 and Bowers in the 9th. Finally a roster that matches the perennial-contender résumé.

futures.name: Collin Krum
futures.case: Bijan stays, London and Judkins came with him. Still one piece from the ring after last year's title-game trip.

futures.name: JD Daley
futures.case: Jefferson, Josh Allen, and Rice kept in the 7th. Boom-or-bust just built the boom version.

futures.name: James Brochu
futures.case: Lamb, Nico, Breece, and ETN kept in the 8th. Jigalos is back in the mix.

futures.name: George Travis
futures.case: CMC at 2, Kyren and Javonte behind him. The commissioner always drafts a team you have to game-plan.

futures.name: Jared Hall
futures.case: Taylor and Nabers are the spine. Three rings say don't bury him after a 7-7 reset.

futures.name: Vincent Cannarozzi
futures.case: JSN and Jeanty up top. The Nabers era is over; this is the rebuild that has to hit.

futures.name: Trevor Hash
futures.case: Gibbs 1.01 and Chase Brown kept in the 9th. The RBs are elite — the rest has to catch up.

futures.name: German Haro
futures.case: Cook and Henry in the first two rounds. First time in years the roster isn't a two-win sentence.

futures.name: Kyle Fowler
futures.case: AJ Brown, DeVonta, and Skattebo kept in the 8th. Young and thin, but not 3-11 thin.

draftNight.note: 192 picks are in. Gibbs went 1.01, Puka came back in the 9th, Achane in the 12th. Odds are live off the rosters.
